# Package `thaumcraft.api.blocks`

[All packages](README.md)

Types: [`BlocksTC`](#blockstc)

## BlocksTC

```java
public final class BlocksTC
```

The public block registry of the native port.

Forced 1.21.1 change: the original TC4 kept its blocks in `ConfigBlocks` and the original add-on surface kept them in `BlocksTC`; 1.21.1 registers every block in the block registry, so this class resolves the native registry instead of holding a second copy of it. A plain name means `thaumcraft:<name>`.

An original TC4 field name of `ConfigBlocks` (`"blockJar"`, `"blockCosmeticSolid"`) is accepted too and means the block of its metadata 0; `get(String, int)` and `state(String, int)` select another metadata. The names and metadata resolve through `ItemApi.legacyBlockId` and `ItemApi.legacyBlockState` (`docs/api/LEGACY_IDS.md`).

<a id="blockstc-id"></a>
```java
public static ResourceLocation id(String name)
```

Null/empty names throw IllegalArgumentException; malformed namespaced IDs return null, malformed plain paths throw ResourceLocationException. An original field name answers the block of its metadata 0, or null when 1.21.1 has none (an item field has no block); it never throws.

<a id="blockstc-get"></a>
```java
public static Block get(String name)
```

Missing blocks return null; null/empty and malformed names follow `id(String)` rather than a uniformly forgiving lookup.

<a id="blockstc-get-2"></a>
```java
public static Block get(String name, int metadata)
```

The block of an original field name and metadata (`get("blockCosmeticSolid", 4)` is the thaumium block), or null for an unknown metadata, a variant without a 1.21.1 block or an unregistered block. For any other name the metadata is ignored: a native id names one block.

<a id="blockstc-state"></a>
```java
public static BlockState state(String name, int metadata)
```

The block state of an original field name and metadata (`state("blockCosmeticSolid", 1)` is the obsidian tile, `cosmetic_solid_tough[variant=1]`), or for any other name the default state of the named block; null when there is no such block.

<a id="blockstc-islegacyname"></a>
```java
public static boolean isLegacyName(String name)
```

True when the name is an original TC4 `ConfigItems` or `ConfigBlocks` field.

<a id="blockstc-require"></a>
```java
public static Block require(String name)
```

Null/empty or missing names throw IllegalArgumentException; malformed plain paths throw ResourceLocationException.

<a id="blockstc-stack"></a>
```java
public static ItemStack stack(String name)
```

A stack of the named block.

